title: Gemma Open Models Introduction
summary: Google introduced Gemma on February 21, 2024 as a family of lightweight open models, releasing Gemma 2B and Gemma 7B in pretrained and instruction-tuned variants.
significance: A documented public introduction and availability milestone for Google's Gemma open-model family.

verification.note: Google's first-party February 21, 2024 announcement directly establishes the public introduction date, worldwide availability, Gemma family identity, and 2B/7B pretrained and instruction-tuned variants. This record treats the date only as the documented public introduction/availability milestone; no development date, development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred.
